biggest_catch: Three tiers with steep hurdles: the $50 checking tier needs the friend to hold a $1,000+/month direct deposit, and the $100 auto-loan tier needs a $10,000+ loan whose first payment is made - a plain membership join earns nothing extra.
catches: Tiered payout to the referring member: $50 for a new member with active checking, $75 for active credit card, $100 for an auto/recreational vehicle loan.
Active checking: direct deposit of $1,000+ per month + enrolled in eStatements, eNotices, and eAlerts.
Active credit card: at least 10 purchases on the NCACU credit card.
Auto/RV loan: over $10,000 with the first payment made; indirect loans do not qualify.
Friend must not have been an NCACU member in the past 12 months; referrer must be an existing member; both need a valid US taxpayer ID.
Bonus paid ~90 days from membership opening if accounts still open, active, and in good standing; no bonus if criteria not met within 90 days.
One new member offer per product type per SSN; consumer accounts only.
Limited time offer; program may be modified or cancelled at any time without notice; bonuses reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

steps: Tell friends about NCACU and give them your referral information.
Friend joins NCACU (not a member in the past 12 months) and presents the program at account opening.
Friend completes a product tier within 90 days: active checking ($1,000+/mo DD), active credit card (10 purchases), or $10k+ auto/RV loan with first payment.
You receive $50/$75/$100 per referral ~90 days after their membership opened.
timing: Referral bonus paid approximately 90 days from new membership opening if accounts remain open, active, and in good standing.
when_cash_arrives: Referral bonus paid approximately 90 days from new membership opening if accounts remain open, active, and in good standing. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
